callPlan.title: Call Plan
callPlan.summary: Inbound telephony routing plan (menu, skill match, queue overflow)
callPlan.description: Configuration of an inbound call flow: which numbers it answers, the ordered routing steps (menu, skill match, queue overflow), opening hours and the fallback action taken outside them. Mapped to Schema.org Schedule.

name.description: Display name of the call plan (schema:name)
name.title: Name

triggerNumbers.description: Phone number(s) in E.164 format this plan answers
triggerNumbers.title: Trigger Numbers

routingSteps.description: Ordered routing steps evaluated on an inbound call

step.title: Step
step.description: Routing step type evaluated at this position in the plan

skill.title: Skill
skill.description: Skill slug matched by a skill_match step

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: Queue title targeted by this step

thresholdWaitSeconds.title: Threshold Wait Seconds
thresholdWaitSeconds.description: Wait time in seconds after which a queue_overflow step fires

fallbackRole.title: Fallback Role
fallbackRole.description: Role that receives the call when this step cannot be satisfied

key.title: Key
key.description: Keypad digit the caller presses for this menu option

label.title: Label
label.description: Spoken/displayed label of this menu option

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: Queue title this menu option routes to

options.title: Options
options.description: Menu options offered by a menu step

routingSteps.title: Routing Steps

openingHours.description: Opening hours the plan applies to (e.g. 'Mo-Fr 08:00-17:00'); empty means 24/7 (schema:byDay)
openingHours.title: Opening Hours

fallbackAction.description: Action taken outside opening hours or when every routing step fails
fallbackAction.title: Fallback Action

priority.description: Matching priority when several plans answer the same number; higher wins
priority.title: Priority

isActive.description: Whether this call plan is active
isActive.title: Active

callTransfer.title: Call Transfer
callTransfer.summary: A warm transfer of a contact moment to a specialist or a queue
callTransfer.description: Records a warm transfer of a contact moment, with an immutable context snapshot handed over to the receiving specialist. Mapped to Schema.org TransferAction.

contactMoment.description: UUID reference to the contact moment being transferred (schema:object)
contactMoment.title: Contact Moment

fromAgent.description: Nextcloud user UID of the transferring agent (schema:agent)
fromAgent.title: From Agent

toAgent.description: Nextcloud user UID of the receiving specialist; empty when transferring to a queue (schema:recipient)
toAgent.title: To Agent

toQueue.description: UUID reference to the target queue; empty when transferring to a specialist
toQueue.title: To Queue

transferReason.description: Reason the contact moment was transferred
transferReason.title: Transfer Reason

handoverNotes.description: Append-only handover notes written for the receiving specialist
handoverNotes.title: Handover Notes

contextSnapshot.description: Immutable snapshot of the caller context captured at transfer time
contextSnapshot.title: Context Snapshot

accepted.description: Whether the receiving specialist accepted the transfer; unset until answered
accepted.title: Accepted

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp at which the specialist answered (schema:endTime)
acceptedAt.title: Accepted At

rejectionReason.description: Reason the transfer was rejected; empty when accepted
rejectionReason.title: Rejection Reason

startedAt.description: Timestamp at which the warm transfer was initiated (schema:startTime)
startedAt.title: Started At

contactSentiment.title: Contact Sentiment
contactSentiment.summary: Sentiment classification of a contact moment, with an escalation recommendation
contactSentiment.description: Sentiment rating derived from a contact moment's transcript, carrying an escalation recommendation. Mapped to Schema.org Rating: the numeric score is stored as ratingValue.

contactMoment.description: UUID reference to the analysed contact moment (schema:itemReviewed)
contactMoment.title: Contact Moment

ratingValue.description: Sentiment score from -1.0 (very negative) to +1.0 (very positive) (schema:ratingValue)
ratingValue.title: Rating Value

bestRating.description: Highest value the sentiment score can take (schema:bestRating)
bestRating.title: Best Rating

worstRating.description: Lowest value the sentiment score can take (schema:worstRating)
worstRating.title: Worst Rating

triggerTerms.description: Terms detected in the transcript that drove the classification
triggerTerms.title: Trigger Terms

transcriptExcerpt.description: Excerpt of the transcript containing the trigger terms
transcriptExcerpt.title: Transcript Excerpt

escalationRecommended.description: Whether escalation to a supervisor is recommended
escalationRecommended.title: Escalation Recommended

createdAt.description: Timestamp at which the classification was made
createdAt.title: Created At

quickAction.title: Quick Action
quickAction.summary: A configurable one-click action available to a contact-centre agent
quickAction.description: A one-click action offered on the agent workspace (provide status, create a case, register a complaint, transfer, schedule a callback, send an email or a document copy). Mapped to Schema.org Action.

name.description: Display name of the quick action (schema:name)
name.title: Name

actionType.description: Action performed when the agent triggers it
actionType.title: Action Type

requiredContext.description: Context conditions that must hold before the action is offered
requiredContext.title: Required Context

targetCaseType.description: Target case-type slug used by new_case actions
targetCaseType.title: Target Case Type

template.description: Template reference used by send_email / send_document_copy actions
template.title: Template

permissions.description: Nextcloud groups allowed to run this action
permissions.title: Permissions

sortOrder.description: Display order of the action on the agent workspace
sortOrder.title: Sort Order

routingRule.title: Routing Rule
routingRule.summary: Keyword/context routing rule assigning a contact moment to a team and a queue
routingRule.description: Configuration only — deliberately carries no x-schema-org marker, because a routing rule is not a Schema.org thing (kcc-schemaorg-model: 'Routing rules carry no schema.org type').

priority.description: Evaluation priority; lower numbers are evaluated first
priority.title: Priority

matchConditions.description: Conditions that must all match for the rule to fire

type.title: Condition Type
type.description: Type of match condition evaluated against the contact moment

matchConditions.title: Match Conditions

assignedTeam.description: Destination team when the rule fires
assignedTeam.title: Assigned Team

assignedQueue.description: UUID reference to the destination queue when the rule fires
assignedQueue.title: Assigned Queue

escalationTeam.description: Fallback team when no agent is available in the assigned team
escalationTeam.title: Escalation Team

complaintCategory.title: Complaint Category
complaintCategory.summary: Configurable complaint category with default handler and SLA override
complaintCategory.description: Per-tenant complaint category — defines the default handler, an SLA override in working days and whether new complaints may be filed against it. Replaces the former five-value complaint.category enum. Mapped to Schema.org DefinedTerm.

defaultHandler.description: Default handler: a Nextcloud user ID, or a group ID prefixed with 'group:'
defaultHandler.title: Default Handler

slaOverride.description: Resolution deadline in working days, overriding the default Awb term
slaOverride.title: SLA Override

isActive.description: Whether new complaints can be filed against this category
isActive.title: Active

complaintDisposition.title: Complaint Disposition
complaintDisposition.summary: Formal judgment closing a complaint under Awb chapter 9
complaintDisposition.description: The formal disposition that closes a complaint: the judgment, its explanation, the measures taken and the closing letter. Mapped to Schema.org Review — it reviews the complaint it closes.

complaint.description: UUID reference to the complaint this disposition closes (schema:itemReviewed)
complaint.title: Complaint

explanation.description: Explanation of the judgment; required when the judgment is upheld or partially_upheld (schema:reviewBody)
explanation.title: Explanation

measures.description: Measures taken or promised in response to the complaint

description.title: Description
description.description: Description of the measure taken to address the complaint

responsible.title: Responsible
responsible.description: Person or department responsible for implementing this measure

measures.title: Measures

closedAt.description: Date on which the complaint was formally closed
closedAt.title: Closed At

closingLetter.description: Reference to the formal response letter document
closingLetter.title: Closing Letter

approvedBy.description: Nextcloud user UID of the coordinator who approved this disposition
approvedBy.title: Approved By

approvalStatus.description: Approval workflow status when coordinator approval is required
approvalStatus.title: Approval Status

hearing.title: Hearing
hearing.summary: Hearing held on a complaint under Awb chapter 9
hearing.description: The hearing (hoorgesprek) held before a complaint is disposed of: scheduling, participants, attendees, report and conclusion. Mapped to Schema.org Event.

complaint.description: UUID reference to the complaint this hearing belongs to (schema:about)
complaint.title: Complaint

date.description: Scheduled date and time of the hearing (schema:startDate)
date.title: Date

attendees.description: Actual attendees, recorded after the hearing
attendees.title: Attendees

report.description: Summary of the hearing; required once the hearing is completed
report.title: Report

conclusion.description: Preliminary conclusion drawn from the hearing
conclusion.title: Conclusion

completedAt.description: Date on which the hearing actually took place (schema:endDate)
completedAt.title: Completed At

talkRoomUrl.description: Nextcloud Talk room URL used for a video hearing
talkRoomUrl.title: Talk Room URL

calendarEventId.description: Nextcloud Calendar event ID of the hearing invitation
calendarEventId.title: Calendar Event ID

objects.description: Complaint about the service provided by the organisation.

objects.name: Communication

objects.name: Staff conduct
